new_entities.name: CashDepositTransaction
new_entities.description: A branch cash deposit transaction. Tracks the deposit amount, customer identity, AML threshold reporting status, and account credit. Owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001).

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this cash deposit transaction

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: FK to customer making the deposit

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: FK to account to be credited

fields.name: staff_id
fields.description: FK to PER-056 branch staff member handling the deposit

fields.name: identity_verification_method
fields.description: Method used to verify customer identity at branch

fields.name: cash_count_verified
fields.description: Whether cash count matches stated amount

fields.name: aml_threshold_exceeded
fields.description: Whether amount exceeds £10,000 MLR 2017 R37 threshold

fields.name: aml_report_ref
fields.description: AML threshold report reference (if aml_threshold_exceeded = true)

fields.name: credited_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when account was credited

design_decisions: CashDepositTransaction owned by SVC-001 — it is a Retail Banking transaction.
AML report generation is triggered by aml_threshold_exceeded = true; EVT-166 notifies SVC-015.

referenced_existing_entities.name: CurrentAccount
referenced_existing_entities.purpose: Account to be credited with the cash deposit
